description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a test application for graphics buffer handling, including server and client buffer classes, buffer creation, monitoring, and a command-line interface for interaction.

classes.name: ServerBuffer
classes.description: A server-side graphics buffer class managing buffer creation, monitoring, and rendering state.

classes.name: ClientBuffer
classes.description: A client-side graphics buffer class handling rendering and publication notifications.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Handles request dispatching for buffer management, including adding, removing, and processing buffer requests.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Inner class for handling privileged request callbacks within Dispatcher.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ServerBuffer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds an existing ServerBuffer by callsign.

methods.name: IsDirty
methods.description: Checks if the server buffer has been marked as dirty.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a buffer for use, resetting the dirty flag.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Handles buffer request logic, marking buffer as dirty and simulating rendering.

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Marks the buffer as published and visible.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ClientBuffer instance with provided descriptors.

methods.name: Rendered
methods.description: Notification that the buffer has been rendered.

methods.name: Published
methods.description: Notification that the buffer has been published.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the dispatcher with an associated ID.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a buffer from the dispatcher by ID.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests buffer descriptors for a given ID.
